message: Upgraded 3 url(s) from http to https
132 equation(s) already MathML; left as real math. Contrast inside them is measured by computed style rather than by axe, which cannot judge operator glyphs.
Caption for Figure_01_04_001 is label-only ("Figure 1"); kept so the cross-reference resolves, not used as an alt source
Table declares role="presentation"; left as the publisher marked it
Applied Canvas table guidance: 100% width, visible borders, centered captions, and ledger-style row striping where missing.
3 image alt text value(s) shortened to Canvas's 120-character limit
Added the source and license block required by D9
Applied the Canvas page template: title banner, heading rules, and footer.
